answer: The sonnet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The beacon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the echo is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
